definitions.gloss: in name only; nominal; only in title
definitions.explanation: Describes something or someone that holds a title, name, or label but lacks the substance, authority, or quality that the name implies. Carries a critical or dismissive nuance.

examples.japanese: {名|な}ばかり⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{管理職|かんりしょく}→管理職：21834_kanrishoku⟧だ。
examples.english: He's a manager in name only.

examples.japanese: ⟦ここ→ここ：00961_koko⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{名|な}ばかり⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{高級|こうきゅう}→高級：08644_koukyuu⟧⟦レストラン→レストラン：01048_resutoran⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{普通|ふつう}→普通：01502_futsuu⟧だった。
examples.english: This is a supposedly high-end restaurant in name only; the food was ordinary.

examples.japanese: {名|な}ばかり⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{改革|かいかく}→改革：04815_kaikaku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{国民|こくみん}→国民：02757_kokumin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{信頼|しんらい}→信頼：03268_shinrai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{得|え}られない→得る：02014_eru⟧。
examples.english: Reforms in name only will not win the trust of the people.

notes:
USAGE:
{名|な}ばかり modifies nouns with ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧: {名|な}ばかり⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{社長|しゃちょう}→社長：01428_shachou⟧ (a president in name only). It is a critical expression implying that the reality does not match the label. The word is a compound of ⟦{名|な}→名：03496_na⟧ (name) + ⟦ばかり→〜ばかり：02006_bakari⟧ (only/just).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {名|な}ばかり⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{社長|しゃちょう}→社長：01428_shachou⟧ (president in name only)
- {名|な}ばかり⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{専門家|せんもんか}→専門家：03088_senmonka⟧ (expert in name only)
- {名|な}ばかり⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{自由|じゆう}→自由：01148_jiyuu⟧ (freedom in name only)

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦{形|かたち}→形：02193_katachi⟧⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ means 'only for show' or 'only in form' and is close in meaning. ⟦{有名無実|ゆうめいむじつ}→有名無実：06459_yuumeimujitsu⟧ is a four-character idiom meaning 'in name but not in reality.' {名|な}ばかり is the most commonly used in everyday speech.
